description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 22, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before gate, starting at approximately 0.03 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.005 at layer 22, remaining relatively steady across the layers. The orange dotted line represents the sparsity ratio after gate, beginning at around 0.85 at layer 0 and declining to approximately 0.03 at layer 22, with a notable drop to around 0.15 by layer 5. The green dashed line represents the sparsity ratio after average gate, starting at about 0.7 at layer 0, decreasing to roughly 0.01 at layer 22, and also showing a significant drop to around 0.2 by layer 5.
